title: Register with the long service leave scheme (contract cleaning industry)
summary: Learn about the Long Service Corporation's scheme for workers in the contract cleaning business in NSW.
intro:
The Long Service Corporation (LSC) manages a portable long service benefits scheme for workers in the contract cleaning business in NSW.

The scheme covers full-time, part-time and casual cleaners employed by a business, or self-employed as a contractor, who do cleaning work under contract.

If you engage workers to do cleaning work in NSW, you must:
who_can_apply: Full-time, part-time, and casual cleaners employed by a business.
Self-employed contractors who do cleaning work under contract.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Employer registration application – Contract cleaning industry'.

how_to_steps.text: Submit your application by email or post to the details on the form.
